Title: General availability: Azure Cognitive Services Text Analytics for Health

Body.Content:
Now in general availability, use Text Analytics for Health to detect words and phrases mentioned in unstructured text as entities in the healthcare and biomedical domain.

General availability of Text Analytics for Health will also introduce new features:

-Genomics category enhanced, now includes gene/protein, variant, mutation type and expression

-Detect conditionality E.g., “if fever (hypothetical), then XYZ (conditional)"

-Detect certainly E.g., “patients with possible NHL”

-Detect association E.g., "patient's mother had history of cancer"

-Sematic relationships enhanced and expanded to include several dozens of relation types

Read the blog.

Watch the Build announcement.
